title: 第二十二章展示之威第二十二章展示之威
content_zh:
;;
“小子！”
“尔敢！！”
“杀！！”
等大长老反应过来时，秦风赫然来到了第二位长老面前，手中龙爪已然抓向其头颅。
好在这位长老反应及时，同样施展游龙身法，这才躲过致命一击，但左肩膀依旧被秦风抓住，伴随着一声“啊”的惨叫声响起，便见其左臂被秦风硬生生给扯断了！！
噗！！
鲜血暴涌，溅射天空。
“我要你死！！”
“啊！！！”
吃痛之下，这位被秦风所伤的长老挥舞右拳，轰向秦风的脑袋。
眼看自己没有将这位长老一击毙命，秦风也不犹豫，再次出招，迎面抓向挥舞而来的拳威。
与此同时，其他几位长老也都回过神来，一个个跟随大长老出手，各种招式齐齐砸向秦风，压根没有手下留情之意。
面对四面八方而来的攻击，秦风丝毫不惧，眼里只有眼前这位长老的性命！！！
“老家伙！！”
“下地狱去吧！！”
“喝呀！！”
随着秦风话落，黑龙爪威和拳威碰撞在了一起，恐怖的龙气爆发，竟瞬间瓦解了这位龙家长老的攻势。
“怎么可能！！”
“你！到底有多么强大的实力？”

“不！！”
眼看自己的拳威竟被秦风轻易化解，加上左臂被扯断，方才还愤怒至极的龙家长老，此刻脑海里不由想起了另一位长老被秦风给一爪爆头的场景，死亡的恐惧感顿时袭遍全身，身为龙城之中高高在上的龙家长老，也情不自禁的发出了绝望哀嚎。
听到这位龙家长老的哀嚎声，秦风并没有一丝怜悯，而是将黑龙爪威重重轰在了他的胸膛之处。
砰！
一声巨响，恐怖的能量爆发，长老身躯瞬间被轰飞了出去，重重砸在了龙城城墙上。
可此时的秦风也陷入了四面夹击的绝境之中。
几位长老的联手攻势近在咫尺，无论前进还是后退，都以来不及躲闪，唯有全力防御，才有一线生机。
“小子！！受死吧！！”
大长老招式之威尤为骇人，他目眦欲裂，恨不得立马将眼前的秦风碎尸万段。
“看来这一次，只能硬抗了。”
“玉灵，能帮忙吸收部分能量吗？”
秦风深呼吸一口气道。
“可以的主人，但以你现在的情况，不宜久战，还是暂时脱身比较好。”
“亦或者回到死亡森林里，借助地形优势，慢慢猎杀龙家修士也行。”
“这对主人而言，未必不是一场修行。”
content_en:
;;
"Boy!"
"How dare you!!"
"Kill!!"
When the first elder reacted, Qin Feng suddenly arrived in front of the second elder, with the dragon claw in his hand already grabbing his head.
Fortunately, the elder reacted in time and used the Wandering Dragon Body Technique to escape the fatal blow. However, his left shoulder was still grabbed by Qin Feng. With a scream of "ah", his left arm was torn off by Qin Feng! !
puff! !
Blood surged and splashed into the sky.
"I want you to die!!"
"Ah!!!"
In pain, the elder who was injured by Qin Feng waved his right fist and hit Qin Feng's head.
Seeing that he failed to kill the elder with one blow, Qin Feng did not hesitate and struck again, catching the incoming punch head-on.
At the same time, several other elders also came to their senses, and followed the elder elder one by one to attack Qin Feng with all kinds of moves, showing no mercy at all.
Facing attacks from all directions, Qin Feng was not afraid at all. He only had eyes for the life of the elder in front of him! ! !
"Old guy!!"
"Go to hell!!"
"Drink!!"
As Qin Feng finished speaking, the power of the black dragon's claws and fists collided, and the terrifying dragon energy exploded, instantly disintegrating the offensive of the elder Long Clan.
"How is that possible!!"
"You! How powerful are you?"
"No!!"
Seeing that the power of his fist was easily neutralized by Qin Feng, and his left arm was torn off, the elder of the Long family who was extremely angry just now couldn't help but think of the scene where another elder was hit in the head by Qin Feng's claw. The fear of death suddenly hit his body. As the elder of the Long family who was aloof in Dragon City, he couldn't help but let out a desperate cry.
Hearing the wail of the elder of the dragon family, Qin Feng showed no mercy, but struck the black dragon's claws heavily on his chest.
Bang!
There was a loud noise and a terrifying energy explosion. The elder's body was instantly blown away and hit the wall of Dragon City heavily.
But at this time, Qin Feng was also in a desperate situation, surrounded by enemies from all sides.
The joint attack of several elders is so close. No matter whether they are advancing or retreating, there is no time to dodge. Only by fully defending can we have a chance of survival.
"Boy!! Suffer death!!"
The power of the Great Elder's moves was particularly frightening. His eyes were about to burst, and he wished he could immediately cut Qin Feng in front of him into pieces.
"It seems that this time, we can only resist forcefully."
"Yu Ling, can you help absorb some of the energy?"
Qin Feng took a deep breath and said.
"It's okay, Master, but given your current situation, it's not advisable to fight for a long time. It's better to get away temporarily."
"Or you can go back to the Death Forest and take advantage of the terrain to slowly hunt down the Long family monks."
"For the master, this may not be a practice."
